scope: Generic synthetic data only. Small deterministic sample, no generalization claim.

criteria.duplicate_restart: Persisted plan and duplicate event do not repeat action; new dependent event executes once.
criteria.stale_idempotent: Expired lease may retry idempotent action with stable key; old result cannot commit.
criteria.stale_nonidempotent: Unknown non-idempotent effect blocks; no automatic replay.
criteria.lease_exact_boundary_holdout: Result at exact expiry is stale, and recovery after reopen claims once with same key.
criteria.permission: Denied permission consumes zero attempts and independent branch can continue.
criteria.cancel: Cancellation wins over inflight completion and stops only owned monitor.
criteria.artifact_good_missing_tampered: Matching actual bytes pass, absent or changed bytes never complete.
criteria.empty_artifact_holdout: An explicitly declared zero-byte artifact is allowed by byte-integrity verifier; semantic adequacy remains untested.
criteria.dependency_proof: Changed upstream artifact prevents downstream dispatch and invalidates completed descendants.
criteria.handoff_good_corrupt: Actual artifact digest mismatch rejects; valid original bytes accept.
criteria.handoff_version_mismatch: Consumer must detect v2 versus v1 mismatch; existing local validator has no consumer-version argument, so accept is a recorded false negative, not a passing semantic check.
criteria.codeorganization: Host must read active references and source content, preserve requested scope and historical CODEMAP rows, avoid deletion and redundant commentary. No program-level semantic certification.
